reason: Both respected her refusal and reached the correct diagnosis (debris in the pump filter after a squashed hose) without recommending a part, but Conversation 1 followed the sensible order (hose check first, then controlled draining), and when she offered her husband it gave him a clear, safe procedure (unplug, emergency tube into a shallow tray, towels, clear debris, check impeller) with engineer escalation reserved for OE persisting after a clear filter. Conversation 2 had her drain water before checking the hose, and its final turn jumped straight to 'call an engineer' without ever asking whether a family member could clean the filter, which is premature escalation for a likely coin blockage. Conversation 1's safety framing was also more thorough (keep door shut, drain a little at a time), making it the more useful and proportionate help.
